caption: The drawing features a symmetrical, stylized floral motif with a central vase-like shape that has a flaring top. From the top of the vase shape, petal-like forms extend outward in alternating colors of dark red, blue, and brown, with accents of beige and cream. The stem and branches emerging from the vase are light beige and curve outward, carrying smaller leaf and bud shapes in shades of yellow, brown, blue, and red. Near the bottom of the vase, there is a circular, daisy-like flower with dark green petals and a yellow center. The lower end of the vase has a leaf composed of red, white, brown, and beige segments. Other areas of the motif include additional small stylized flowers in red and yellow, and a blue, cloud-like shape on the right. The background is a plain off-white or cream color. There is neatly printed text in the lower right corner that reads: "CORNER MOTIF - COLOR #3 MAJEA O OLAFSON - TROM."
title: Design from a Proposed Portfolio
